messages:
claire: quick UX review of the catalog compare in dense mode. spotted a few small but impactful things: filter chips visually persist after switching out of compare, the tiny 'Perf' pill is ambiguous, and pinned-version action gets lost in tight rows. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/dense-compare.png

ben: yep saw the chip ghosting too. repro: apply 'cpu' + 'quant', open compare, deselect, then click 'All models' 94 chips stay highlighted even though results are unfiltered.

anika: for clarity we should keep chip visuals strictly tied to applied filters. if a row is just selected for compare, show an outline style "compare-only" marker instead. avoids mismatch for screen readers.

sam: perf pill: people read "Perf" as generic quality. suggestion: change label to "Latency" and show "ms" inside tooltip. maybe a tiny sparkline in expanded legend, not in row.

claire: pin icon conflict: filled-pin used for list-pinning and version-pinning. propose bookmark icon + inline tiny label like "Pinned v2025-02-14" (left of name in dense view) so it doesn't vanish.

ben: accessibility: announce pin changes via a polite live region: "Pinned version 2025-02-14 for Model X". but keep live messages minimal to avoid spam.

anika: keyboard focus: when opening compare drawer move focus to the heading and trap focus (role=dialog aria-modal=true). on close, restore focus to previously focused row. code hint: set heading tabindex=-1 then heading.focus().

sam: CSS/animation note: toggling density does a big layout shift. in dense switch prefer cross-fade + scale rather than translate to reduce jank.

product-bot: action items: 1) Ben 94 remove visual-only chip active class on route change (PR). 2) Sam 94 update Figma: bookmark icon + tooltip color tokens. 3) Anika 94 draft aria-live wording + compare-only visual spec. deadlines: next Tue.

claire: thanks team 94 let's roll the visual fixes + a11y changes in the next patch. :rocket:
